problem.question: A long circular rod of diameter 10 mm is placed across a uniform, slow stream of air (0.15 m/s, ~20 degC).  Estimate the time-mean drag coefficient and the vortex-shedding Strouhal number of the rod, per unit span, to within 3 % each.  Treat the stream as unbounded.

notes: parent has no periodic stationary state: fresh perturbed start with the parent's run length (mapping a non-shedding field could suppress shedding the child would develop)
